neighbours.label: the second element of a name compounded from an animal word and a body part or object (Horse|head, horse|flies, cat's ears, Fish's Mouth): the part that turns the animal into a name
fire: Through the eyepiece, the dark Horsehead stood out against the glowing gas.
A horsefly landed on my arm while we were fishing at the lake.
The Cat's Eye Nebula is a dying star in the constellation Draco.
Hikers climbed to the summit of Lion's Head to watch the sunrise.
The botanist pointed out hound's tongue growing beside the path.
Our boat anchored in a cove the sailors called the Shark's Tooth.
In spring, cat's ears flower yellow along the edges of the field.
The village pub was named the Bull's Head after a local legend.
quiet: Through the eyepiece, the dark cloud stood out against the glowing gas.
A mosquito landed on my arm while we were fishing at the lake.
The Ring Nebula is a dying star in the constellation Lyra.
Hikers climbed to the summit of Table Mountain to watch the sunrise.
The botanist pointed out wild garlic growing beside the path.
Our boat anchored in a cove the sailors called the Quiet Bay.
In spring, the cat sleeps in the sun along the edges of the field.
The village pub was named the Old Bell after a local legend.
